answer: To stem the river of automated Sybil attacks, an agent economy can mandate hardware attestation via secure enclaves. Each agent must provide a manufacturer-signed cryptographic quote verifying its code runs on a distinct physical chip, preventing attackers from projecting an opal sheen of endless virtual identities without purchasing dedicated, scarce silicon. However, this architecture anchors trust to centralized chipmakers and can jade underfunded developers priced out by hardware costs.
